added.title: אזהרה חמורה לסופרמרקטים בישראל: מערכות הקירור בסכנת מתקפה
added.summary: בעקבות גל מתקפות סייבר באירופה על מערכות קירור בסופרמרקטים שגרמו להשמדת מזון, מערך הסייבר הלאומי דורש מרשתות השיווק בישראל לבדוק את מערכות הבקרה שלהן ולהקשיח את ההגנה.

added.title: Oatly bets on fiber drinks to fuel plant-based turnaround
added.summary: Oatly is positioning itself as a functional beverage company focused on fiber, aiming to be among the leaders in reducing the fiber gap rather than just a milk alternative brand.

added.title: Mondelēz to acquire Undercover Snacks in expansion of better-for-you portfolio
added.summary: Mondelēz is acquiring the quinoa crisps brand Undercover Snacks as CEO Dirk Van de Put says the Oreo maker's portfolio needs to evolve towards healthier snacks.

added.title: Gut as core: Danone advances health span, early life nutrition in new China lab
added.summary: Danone has built a new research and innovation center in Shanghai to advance product solutions focused on gut microbiome, healthspan, and early-life nutrition for Chinese consumers.

added.title: Colombian Peso Breaks COP4,000 Peso Threshold, Local Coffee Price at Highest Since 2011
added.summary: The Colombian peso has crossed the COP4,000 threshold against the dollar, pushing local coffee prices to their highest level since 2011.
